11|from datetime import datetime, timezone

15|_hermes_profile = os.environ.get("HERMES_PROFILE", "")
16|_hermes_home = Path(os.environ.get("HERMES_HOME", os.path.expanduser("~/.hermes")))
17|_hermes_root = (_hermes_home / "profiles" / _hermes_profile) if _hermes_profile and "profiles" not in str(_hermes_home) else _hermes_home
18|SKILLS_ROOT = Path(os.environ.get("HERMES_SKILLS_ROOT", str(_hermes_root / "skills")))
19|SECURITY_ROOT = Path(os.environ.get("HERMES_SKILLS_SECURITY_ROOT", os.path.expanduser("~/.hermes/skills-security")))
20|REPORTS_ROOT = SECURITY_ROOT / "reports"
21|STATE_PATH = SECURITY_ROOT / "state.json"
22|ALLOWLIST_PATH = SECURITY_ROOT / "allowlist.json"
23|PENDING_PATH = SECURITY_ROOT / "pending_quarantine.json"
24|QUARANTINE_ROOT = Path(os.environ.get("HERMES_SKILLS_QUARANTINE_ROOT", os.path.expanduser("~/.hermes/skills-quarantine")))
25|SKILLSPECTOR_BIN = os.environ.get("SKILLSPECTOR_BIN", os.path.expanduser("~/.local/bin/skillspector"))
26|DEFAULT_THRESHOLD = int(os.environ.get("HERMES_SKILLS_QUARANTINE_SCORE", "60"))

29|@dataclass
30|class SkillResult:
31|    rel: str
32|    path: Path
33|    name: str
34|    bundled: bool
35|    hash: str
36|    scan_exit: int
37|    score: int | None
38|    severity: str | None
39|    recommendation: str | None
40|    findings: int
41|    raw: dict[str, Any]
42|    stdout_path: Path
43|    quarantined_to: str | None = None
44|    baseline_trusted: bool = False
45|    allowlisted: bool = False
46|    quarantine_proposed: bool = False

48|
49|def now_iso() -> str:
50|    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
51|
52|
53|def ensure_dirs() -> None:
54|    REPORTS_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
55|    QUARANTINE_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
56|
57|
58|def load_bundled_names() -> set[str]:
59|    manifest = SKILLS_ROOT / ".bundled_manifest"
60|    bundled = set()
61|    if manifest.exists():
62|        for line in manifest.read_text().splitlines():
63|            if ":" in line:
64|                bundled.add(line.split(":", 1)[0].strip())
65|    return bundled
66|
67|
68|def find_skill_dirs() -> list[Path]:
69|    seen = set()
70|    skill_dirs = []
71|    for p in SKILLS_ROOT.rglob("SKILL.md"):
72|        rel_parts = p.relative_to(SKILLS_ROOT).parts[:-1]
73|        if any(part.startswith(".") for part in rel_parts):
74|            continue
75|        parent = p.parent
76|        if parent not in seen:
77|            seen.add(parent)
78|            skill_dirs.append(parent)
79|    return sorted(skill_dirs)
80|
81|
82|def result_from_cache(path: Path, bundled_names: set[str], cached: dict[str, Any], file_hash_value: str) -> SkillResult:
83|    rel = path.relative_to(SKILLS_ROOT).as_posix()
84|    report = Path(str(cached.get("report", REPORTS_ROOT / (rel.replace("/", "__") + ".json"))))
85|    raw: dict[str, Any] = {}
86|    if report.exists():
87|        try:
88|            loaded = json.loads(report.read_text())
89|            if isinstance(loaded, dict):
90|                raw = loaded
91|        except Exception:
92|            raw = {"cache_read_error": True}
93|    findings_raw = raw.get("findings", [])
94|    findings = findings_raw if isinstance(findings_raw, list) else []
95|    return SkillResult(
96|        rel=rel,
97|        path=path,
98|        name=path.name,
99|        bundled=path.name in bundled_names,
100|        hash=file_hash_value,
101|        scan_exit=int(cached.get("scan_exit", 0)),
102|        score=cached.get("score") if isinstance(cached.get("score"), int) else None,
103|        severity=cached.get("severity") if isinstance(cached.get("severity"), str) else None,
104|        recommendation=cached.get("recommendation") if isinstance(cached.get("recommendation"), str) else None,
105|        findings=len(findings),
106|        raw=raw,
107|        stdout_path=report,
108|        quarantined_to=cached.get("quarantined_to") if isinstance(cached.get("quarantined_to"), str) else None,
109|    )
110|
111|def file_hash(path: Path) -> str:
112|    h = hashlib.sha256()
113|    for p in sorted(x for x in path.rglob("*") if x.is_file() and ".hub" not in x.parts):
114|        rel = p.relative_to(path).as_posix().encode()
115|        h.update(rel)
116|        h.update(b"\0")
117|        h.update(p.read_bytes())
118|        h.update(b"\0")
119|    return h.hexdigest()
120|
121|
122|def load_state() -> dict[str, Any]:
123|    if STATE_PATH.exists():
124|        return json.loads(STATE_PATH.read_text())
125|    return {
126|        "version": 1,
127|        "created_at": now_iso(),
128|        "approved_hashes": {},
129|        "last_results": {},
130|        "last_run": None,
131|    }
132|
133|
134|def save_state(state: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
135|    SECURITY_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
136|    _tmp = STATE_PATH.with_suffix(".tmp")
137|    _tmp.write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
138|    _tmp.rename(STATE_PATH)
139|
140|
141|def load_allowlist() -> dict[str, Any]:
142|    if ALLOWLIST_PATH.exists():
143|        data = json.loads(ALLOWLIST_PATH.read_text())
144|        if isinstance(data, dict):
145|            return data
146|    return {
147|        "version": 1,
148|        "updated_at": now_iso(),
149|        "skills": {},
150|    }
151|
152|
153|def save_allowlist(allowlist: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
154|    allowlist["updated_at"] = now_iso()
155|    _tmp = ALLOWLIST_PATH.with_suffix(".tmp")
156|    _tmp.write_text(json.dumps(allowlist, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
157|    _tmp.rename(ALLOWLIST_PATH)
158|
159|
160|def load_pending() -> dict[str, Any]:
161|    if PENDING_PATH.exists():
162|        data = json.loads(PENDING_PATH.read_text())
163|        if isinstance(data, dict):
164|            return data
165|    return {"version": 1, "updated_at": now_iso(), "proposals": {}}
166|
167|
168|def save_pending(pending: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
169|    pending["updated_at"] = now_iso()
170|    _tmp = PENDING_PATH.with_suffix(".tmp")
171|    _tmp.write_text(json.dumps(pending, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
172|    _tmp.rename(PENDING_PATH)
173|
174|
175|def is_allowlisted(result: SkillResult, allowlist: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
176|    skill_entry = allowlist.get("skills", {}).get(result.rel)
177|    if not isinstance(skill_entry, dict):
178|        return False
179|    hashes = skill_entry.get("hashes", [])
180|    return isinstance(hashes, list) and result.hash in hashes
181|
182|
183|def populate_allowlist_from_flagged(results: list[SkillResult], allowlist: dict[str, Any], threshold: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
184|    skills = allowlist.setdefault("skills", {})
185|    for r in results:
186|        if r.bundled or (r.score or 0) < threshold:
187|            continue
188|        entry = skills.setdefault(r.rel, {})
189|        entry["hashes"] = sorted(set(entry.get("hashes", [])) | {r.hash})
190|        entry["reason"] = entry.get("reason") or "Explicitly exempted current flagged skill pending manual review"
191|        entry["last_score"] = r.score
192|        entry["last_severity"] = r.severity
193|        entry["recommendation"] = r.recommendation
194|        entry["report"] = str(r.stdout_path)
195|    return allowlist
196|
197|
198|def remove_allowlisted_from_baseline(state: dict[str, Any], allowlist: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
199|    approved = state.setdefault("approved_hashes", {})
200|    for rel in allowlist.get("skills", {}):
201|        approved.pop(rel, None)
202|
203|
204|def scan_skill(path: Path, bundled_names: set[str]) -> SkillResult:
205|    rel = path.relative_to(SKILLS_ROOT).as_posix()
206|    out_path = REPORTS_ROOT / (rel.replace("/", "__") + ".json")
207|    proc = subprocess.run(
208|        [SKILLSPECTOR_BIN, "scan", str(path), "--no-llm", "--format", "json"],
209|        capture_output=True,
210|        text=True,
211|        timeout=180,
212|    )
213|    data: dict[str, Any]
214|    if proc.stdout.strip():
215|        try:
216|            parsed = json.loads(proc.stdout)
217|            data = parsed if isinstance(parsed, dict) else {"raw": parsed}
218|        except json.JSONDecodeError:
219|            data = {
220|                "parse_error": True,
221|                "stdout_prefix": proc.stdout[:2000],
222|                "stderr_prefix": proc.stderr[:2000],
223|            }
224|    else:
225|        data = {"stderr_prefix": proc.stderr[:2000]}
226|    out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
227|    _tmp_out = out_path.with_suffix(".tmp")
228|    _tmp_out.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
229|    _tmp_out.replace(out_path)
230|    risk_raw = data.get("risk_assessment", {})
231|    risk = risk_raw if isinstance(risk_raw, dict) else {}
232|    findings_raw = data.get("findings", [])
233|    findings = findings_raw if isinstance(findings_raw, list) else []
234|    return SkillResult(
235|        rel=rel,
236|        path=path,
237|        name=path.name,
238|        bundled=path.name in bundled_names,
239|        hash=file_hash(path),
240|        scan_exit=proc.returncode,
241|        score=risk.get("score") if isinstance(risk.get("score"), int) else None,
242|        severity=risk.get("severity") if isinstance(risk.get("severity"), str) else None,
243|        recommendation=risk.get("recommendation") if isinstance(risk.get("recommendation"), str) else None,
244|        findings=len(findings),
245|        raw=data,
246|        stdout_path=out_path,
247|    )
248|
249|
250|def should_quarantine(result: SkillResult, state: dict[str, Any], allowlist: dict[str, Any], threshold: int) -> bool:
251|    approved = state.get("approved_hashes", {})
252|    if result.bundled:
253|        return False
254|    if result.allowlisted:
255|        return False
256|    if result.scan_exit not in (0, 1):
257|        return False
258|    if (result.score or 0) < threshold:
259|        return False
260|    if approved.get(result.rel) == result.hash:
261|        return False
262|    return True
263|
264|
265|def quarantine_skill(result: SkillResult) -> str:
266|    ts = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
267|    dest = QUARANTINE_ROOT / ts / result.rel
268|    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
269|    shutil.move(str(result.path), str(dest))
270|    return str(dest)
271|
272|
273|def propose_quarantine(result: SkillResult, pending: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
274|    """Stage a quarantine proposal WITHOUT moving anything. A true-positive
275|    verdict (e.g. from an adversarial-review pass) must confirm via
276|    --confirm-quarantine before quarantine_skill() actually runs."""
277|    proposals = pending.setdefault("proposals", {})
278|    proposals[result.rel] = {
279|        "hash": result.hash,
280|        "score": result.score,
281|        "severity": result.severity,
282|        "recommendation": result.recommendation,
283|        "report": str(result.stdout_path),
284|        "path": str(result.path),
285|        "proposed_at": now_iso(),
286|    }
287|
288|
289|def prune_stale_pending(pending: dict[str, Any], results: list[SkillResult]) -> None:
290|    """Drop pending proposals whose skill vanished or whose hash changed
291|    since the proposal was staged (the file was edited/replaced, so the old
292|    proposal no longer describes what's on disk)."""
293|    proposals = pending.setdefault("proposals", {})
294|    current_hashes = {r.rel: r.hash for r in results}
295|    for rel in list(proposals.keys()):
296|        if rel not in current_hashes or current_hashes[rel] != proposals[rel].get("hash"):
297|            proposals.pop(rel, None)
298|
299|
300|def confirm_quarantine(rel_paths: list[str], pending: dict[str, Any], results: list[SkillResult]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
301|    """Actually move skill(s) into quarantine, but ONLY if there is a matching
302|    pending proposal whose hash still matches the file on disk. This is the
303|    step that should run only after an adversarial scan has confirmed the
304|    flag is a true positive, not a false positive."""
305|    proposals = pending.setdefault("proposals", {})
306|    by_rel = {r.rel: r for r in results}
307|    outcomes = []
308|    for rel in rel_paths:
309|        proposal = proposals.get(rel)
310|        result = by_rel.get(rel)
311|        if proposal is None:
312|            outcomes.append({"skill": rel, "status": "error", "reason": "no pending proposal for this skill"})
313|            continue
314|        if result is None or result.hash != proposal.get("hash"):
315|            outcomes.append({"skill": rel, "status": "error", "reason": "hash mismatch or skill missing; re-run scan before confirming"})
316|            continue
317|        dest = quarantine_skill(result)
318|        result.quarantined_to = dest
319|        proposals.pop(rel, None)
320|        outcomes.append({"skill": rel, "status": "quarantined", "to": dest})
321|    return outcomes
322|
323|
324|def reject_quarantine(rel_paths: list[str], pending: dict[str, Any], results: list[SkillResult], allowlist: dict[str, Any], reason: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
325|    """Mark pending proposal(s) as false positives: add to the allowlist so
326|    they won't be re-proposed on future runs, and clear the pending entry."""
327|    proposals = pending.setdefault("proposals", {})
328|    by_rel = {r.rel: r for r in results}
329|    skills = allowlist.setdefault("skills", {})
330|    outcomes = []
331|    for rel in rel_paths:
332|        proposal = proposals.get(rel)
333|        result = by_rel.get(rel)
334|        if proposal is None and result is None:
335|            outcomes.append({"skill": rel, "status": "error", "reason": "no pending proposal and skill not found"})
336|            continue
337|        h = (proposal or {}).get("hash") or (result.hash if result else None)
338|        entry = skills.setdefault(rel, {})
339|        entry["hashes"] = sorted(set(entry.get("hashes", [])) | ({h} if h else set()))
340|        entry["reason"] = reason
341|        if result is not None:
342|            entry["last_score"] = result.score
343|            entry["last_severity"] = result.severity
344|            entry["recommendation"] = result.recommendation
345|            entry["report"] = str(result.stdout_path)
346|        proposals.pop(rel, None)
347|        outcomes.append({"skill": rel, "status": "allowlisted"})
348|    return outcomes
349|
350|
351|def summarize(results: list[SkillResult], threshold: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
352|    return {
353|        "skills": len(results),
354|        "bundled": sum(1 for r in results if r.bundled),
355|        "non_bundled": sum(1 for r in results if not r.bundled),
356|        "severity_counts": dict(Counter((r.severity or "UNKNOWN") for r in results)),
357|        "allowlisted": [
358|            {
359|                "skill": r.rel,
360|                "score": r.score,
361|                "severity": r.severity,
362|                "report": str(r.stdout_path),
363|            }
364|            for r in results if r.allowlisted
365|        ],
366|        "quarantined": [
367|            {"skill": r.rel, "score": r.score, "severity": r.severity, "to": r.quarantined_to}
368|            for r in results if r.quarantined_to
369|        ],
370|        "pending_quarantine": [
371|            {"skill": r.rel, "score": r.score, "severity": r.severity, "report": str(r.stdout_path)}
372|            for r in results if r.quarantine_proposed
373|        ],
374|        "flagged": [
375|            {
376|                "skill": r.rel,
377|                "score": r.score,
378|                "severity": r.severity,
379|                "recommendation": r.recommendation,
380|                "bundled": r.bundled,
381|                "baseline_trusted": r.baseline_trusted,
382|                "allowlisted": r.allowlisted,
383|                "report": str(r.stdout_path),
384|            }
385|            for r in results if (r.score or 0) >= threshold
386|        ],
387|    }
388|
389|
390|def main() -> int:
391|    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Scan Hermes skills with SkillSpector and optionally quarantine risky future additions.")
392|    parser.add_argument("--refresh-baseline", action="store_true", help="Trust the current hashes of all existing skills and reset approved baseline.")
393|    parser.add_argument("--enforce", action="store_true", help="Stage new or changed non-bundled skills whose score meets the threshold as quarantine PROPOSALS (does not move files). A confirm step is required before anything is actually quarantined.")
394|    parser.add_argument("--threshold", type=int, default=DEFAULT_THRESHOLD, help="Score threshold for quarantine in enforce mode.")
395|    parser.add_argument("--sync-allowlist-from-flagged", action="store_true", help="Write current flagged non-bundled skills into the explicit allowlist and remove them from baseline trust.")
396|    parser.add_argument("--confirm-quarantine", nargs="+", metavar="REL_PATH", help="After an adversarial scan has confirmed a pending proposal is a true positive, actually move the given skill(s) (by rel path, e.g. software-development/foo) from skills/ into quarantine. Fails if the skill has no matching pending proposal or its hash has changed since proposal.")
397|    parser.add_argument("--reject-quarantine", nargs="+", metavar="REL_PATH", help="Mark pending proposal(s) as false positives: add to the allowlist (so they are not re-proposed) and clear the pending entry. Use --reject-reason to record why.")
398|    parser.add_argument("--reject-reason", default="Adversarial review: false positive", help="Reason recorded in the allowlist for --reject-quarantine entries.")
399|    args = parser.parse_args()
400|
401|    ensure_dirs()
402|    state = load_state()
403|    allowlist = load_allowlist()
404|    pending = load_pending()
405|    bundled_names = load_bundled_names()
406|    skill_dirs = find_skill_dirs()
407|    previous_approved = state.get("approved_hashes", {})
408|    cached_results = state.get("last_results", {})
409|    results: list[SkillResult] = []
410|    for path in skill_dirs:
411|        rel = path.relative_to(SKILLS_ROOT).as_posix()
412|        current_hash = file_hash(path)
413|        cached = cached_results.get(rel)
414|        report_path = Path(str(cached.get("report", ""))) if isinstance(cached, dict) else None
415|        allowlisted_hashes = allowlist.get("skills", {}).get(rel, {}).get("hashes", [])
416|        can_reuse_cache = (
417|            not args.refresh_baseline
418|            and isinstance(cached, dict)
419|            and cached.get("hash") == current_hash
420|            and report_path is not None
421|            and report_path.exists()
422|        )
423|        if can_reuse_cache:
424|            results.append(result_from_cache(path, bundled_names, cached, current_hash))
425|        else:
426|            results.append(scan_skill(path, bundled_names))
427|
428|    if args.refresh_baseline:
429|        state["approved_hashes"] = {r.rel: r.hash for r in results}
430|    else:
431|        state.setdefault("approved_hashes", {})
432|        for r in results:
433|            if previous_approved.get(r.rel) == r.hash:
434|                r.baseline_trusted = True
435|
436|    if args.sync_allowlist_from_flagged:
437|        allowlist = populate_allowlist_from_flagged(results, allowlist, args.threshold)
438|        save_allowlist(allowlist)
439|        remove_allowlisted_from_baseline(state, allowlist)
440|
441|    for r in results:
442|        r.allowlisted = is_allowlisted(r, allowlist)
443|
444|    prune_stale_pending(pending, results)
445|
446|    confirm_outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
447|    reject_outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
448|
449|    if args.confirm_quarantine:
450|        confirm_outcomes = confirm_quarantine(args.confirm_quarantine, pending, results)
451|
452|    if args.reject_quarantine:
453|        reject_outcomes = reject_quarantine(args.reject_quarantine, pending, results, allowlist, args.reject_reason)
454|        save_allowlist(allowlist)
455|
456|    if args.enforce:
457|        newly_proposed = []
458|        for r in results:
459|            if should_quarantine(r, state, allowlist, args.threshold):
460|                r.quarantine_proposed = True
461|                propose_quarantine(r, pending)
462|                newly_proposed.append(r.rel)
463|        # Automatically run adversarial review on all pending proposals so
464|        # cron output surfaces FP verdicts without requiring a manual step.
465|        if newly_proposed:
466|            import subprocess as _sp
467|            _adv = Path(__file__).parent / "adversarial_quarantine_review.py"
468|            if _adv.exists():
469|                _res = _sp.run(
470|                    ["python3", str(_adv), "--all-pending"],
471|                    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120,
472|                )
473|                if _res.stdout.strip():
474|                    print("\n--- Adversarial review of new quarantine proposals ---")
475|                    print(_res.stdout.strip())
476|                if _res.returncode not in (0, 1):
477|                    print(f"WARN: adversarial_quarantine_review.py exited {_res.returncode}: {_res.stderr[:200]}")
478|
479|    save_pending(pending)
480|
481|    state["last_results"] = {
482|        r.rel: {
483|            "hash": r.hash,
484|            "score": r.score,
485|            "severity": r.severity,
486|            "recommendation": r.recommendation,
487|            "bundled": r.bundled,
488|            "scan_exit": r.scan_exit,
489|            "report": str(r.stdout_path),
490|            "quarantined_to": r.quarantined_to,
491|            "allowlisted": r.allowlisted,
492|        }
493|        for r in results
494|    }
495|    state["last_run"] = now_iso()
496|    save_state(state)
497|
498|    summary = summarize(results, args.threshold)
499|    summary_path = SECURITY_ROOT / "last-summary.json"
500|    _summary_tmp = summary_path.with_suffix(".tmp")
501|    _summary_tmp.write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
502|    _summary_tmp.rename(summary_path)
503|
504|    lines = [
505|        f"skills={summary['skills']} bundled={summary['bundled']} non_bundled={summary['non_bundled']}",
506|        f"severity_counts={json.dumps(summary['severity_counts'], sort_keys=True)}",
507|        f"allowlisted={len(summary['allowlisted'])}",
508|        f"quarantined={len(summary['quarantined'])}",
509|        f"pending_quarantine={len(summary['pending_quarantine'])}",
510|        f"flagged={len(summary['flagged'])}",
511|        f"summary={summary_path}",
512|        f"allowlist={ALLOWLIST_PATH}",
513|        f"pending={PENDING_PATH}",
514|    ]
515|    if confirm_outcomes:
516|        for o in confirm_outcomes:
517|            if o["status"] == "quarantined":
518|                lines.append(f"CONFIRMED+QUARANTINED {o['skill']} -> {o['to']}")
519|            else:
520|                lines.append(f"CONFIRM FAILED {o['skill']}: {o['reason']}")
521|    if reject_outcomes:
522|        for o in reject_outcomes:
523|            if o["status"] == "allowlisted":
524|                lines.append(f"REJECTED (false positive, allowlisted) {o['skill']}")
525|            else:
526|                lines.append(f"REJECT FAILED {o['skill']}: {o['reason']}")
527|    if summary["quarantined"]:
528|        for item in summary["quarantined"]:
529|            lines.append(f"QUARANTINED {item['skill']} score={item['score']} severity={item['severity']} -> {item['to']}")
530|    if summary["pending_quarantine"]:
531|        for item in summary["pending_quarantine"]:
532|            lines.append(
533|                f"PENDING QUARANTINE (not moved yet) {item['skill']} score={item['score']} severity={item['severity']} "
534|                f"report={item['report']} -- run an adversarial scan against this report before deciding; then "
535|                f"--confirm-quarantine {item['skill']} (true positive) or --reject-quarantine {item['skill']} (false positive)"
536|            )
537|    if not (args.enforce or args.confirm_quarantine or args.reject_quarantine):
538|        if args.sync_allowlist_from_flagged:
539|            lines.append("Explicit allowlist synced from current flagged non-bundled skills and removed from baseline trust.")
540|        elif args.refresh_baseline:
541|            lines.append("Baseline refreshed; current skills trusted by hash for future drift detection.")
542|        else:
543|            changed_high_risk = [
544|                r for r in results
545|                if not r.baseline_trusted and not r.allowlisted and (r.score or 0) >= args.threshold and not r.bundled
546|            ]
547|            if changed_high_risk:
548|                for r in changed_high_risk:
549|                    lines.append(f"FLAGGED {r.rel} score={r.score} severity={r.severity} report={r.stdout_path}")
550|            else:
551|                lines = []
552|    if lines:
553|        print("\n".join(lines))
554|
555|    # Fix C: consume skill-integrity.json and skill-merkle.json
556|    _base_c = Path(os.environ.get("HERMES_HOME", str(Path.home() / ".hermes")))
557|    _profile_c = os.environ.get("HERMES_PROFILE", "")
558|    _cache_root = (
559|        (_base_c / "profiles" / _profile_c)
560|        if _profile_c and "profiles" not in str(_base_c)
561|        else _base_c
562|    ) / "cache"
563|    _drift_count = 0
564|    try:
565|        _integrity_path = _cache_root / "skill-integrity.json"
566|        if _integrity_path.exists():
567|            _integrity_data = json.loads(_integrity_path.read_text())
568|            # Support both a list of entries or a dict keyed by skill
569|            if isinstance(_integrity_data, list):
570|                _integrity_items = _integrity_data
571|            elif isinstance(_integrity_data, dict):
572|                _integrity_items = [
573|                    dict(skill=k, **v) if isinstance(v, dict) else {"skill": k, "status": v}
574|                    for k, v in _integrity_data.items()
575|                ]
576|            else:
577|                _integrity_items = []
578|            for _item in _integrity_items:
579|                if _item.get("status", "ok") != "ok":
580|                    _skill = _item.get("skill", _item.get("name", "unknown"))
581|                    _reason = _item.get("reason", _item.get("status", "unknown"))
582|                    print(f"INTEGRITY-FAIL: {_skill} ({_reason})")
583|                    _drift_count += 1
584|    except Exception:
585|        pass
586|
587|    try:
588|        _merkle_path = _cache_root / "skill-merkle.json"
589|        if _merkle_path.exists():
590|            _merkle_data = json.loads(_merkle_path.read_text())
591|            if isinstance(_merkle_data, list):
592|                _merkle_items = _merkle_data
593|            elif isinstance(_merkle_data, dict):
594|                _merkle_items = [
595|                    dict(skill=k, **v) if isinstance(v, dict) else {"skill": k}
596|                    for k, v in _merkle_data.items()
597|                ]
598|            else:
599|                _merkle_items = []
600|            for _item in _merkle_items:
601|                if _item.get("drift") or _item.get("changed"):
602|                    _skill = _item.get("skill", _item.get("name", "unknown"))
603|                    print(f"MERKLE-DRIFT: {_skill}")
604|                    _drift_count += 1
605|    except Exception:
606|        pass
607|
608|    return 1 if _drift_count > 0 else 0
609|
610|
611|if __name__ == "__main__":
612|    sys.exit(main())

================================================================================
FILE: /var/home/rainbow/.hermes/scripts/skill-graph-reachability-verifier.py  (total lines: 233)
================================================================================
1|#!/usr/bin/python3
2|"""
3|skill-graph-reachability-verifier.py
4|
5|Enables offline verification that multi-skill orchestration plans will
6|actually reach their intended goal state — catches dead-end skill chains
7|before execution wastes budget.
8|
9|Math basis: reachability in a typed directed skill graph
10|  Nodes: skills (identified by name)
11|  Edges: skill A → skill B if A's postconditions satisfy B's preconditions
12|  Goal: given a start skill and target skill, is target reachable via BFS?
13|  Additional check: no-exit nodes (skills with no outgoing edges and
14|  non-terminal postconditions) signal dead-ends in the plan.
15|
16|Usage:
17|  python3 skill-graph-reachability-verifier.py --from SKILL --to SKILL
18|  python3 skill-graph-reachability-verifier.py --plan plan.json
19|  python3 skill-graph-reachability-verifier.py --audit-all
20|  python3 skill-graph-reachability-verifier.py --dry-run
21|"""
22|from __future__ import annotations
23|
24|import argparse
25|import json
26|import re
27|import sys
28|from collections import defaultdict, deque
29|from datetime import datetime, timezone
30|from pathlib import Path
31|
32|HOME       = Path.home()
33|SKILLS_DIR = HOME / ".hermes/skills"
34|FORK_SKILLS = HOME / ".hermes/profiles/fork/skills"
35|CACHE_DIR  = HOME / ".hermes/cache/monitors"
36|CACHE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
37|OUT_FILE      = CACHE_DIR / "skill-graph-reachability-report.json"
38|BASELINE_FILE = CACHE_DIR / "skill-graph-reachability-baseline.json"
39|
40|# Keyword sets for postcondition/precondition matching
41|POSTCOND_HEADERS = re.compile(r"(?i)^#{1,4}\s*(after|output|result|produces?|postcondition)")
42|PRECOND_HEADERS  = re.compile(r"(?i)^#{1,4}\s*(before|requires?|precondition|setup|input)")
43|TERMINAL_WORDS   = {"done", "complete", "finished", "deployed", "saved", "written", "verified"}
44|
45|
46|def _extract_skill_meta(path: Path) -> dict:
47|    """Extract name, precondition keywords, postcondition keywords."""
48|    try:
49|        text  = path.read_text()
50|        lines = text.splitlines()
51|    except Exception:
52|        return {}
53|
54|    name = path.parent.name if path.name == "SKILL.md" else path.stem
55|    pre_kw: set[str] = set()
56|    post_kw: set[str] = set()
57|    mode = None
58|
59|    for line in lines:
60|        if PRECOND_HEADERS.match(line):
61|            mode = "pre"
62|        elif POSTCOND_HEADERS.match(line):
63|            mode = "post"
64|        elif line.startswith("#"):
65|            mode = None
66|
67|        if mode and not line.startswith("#"):
68|            words = set(re.findall(r"[a-z]{4,}", line.lower()))
69|            if mode == "pre":
70|                pre_kw |= words
71|            else:
72|                post_kw |= words
73|
74|    # Fallback: extract from description line (first non-header line)
75|    if not pre_kw and not post_kw:
76|        for line in lines[:20]:
77|            if line.strip() and not line.startswith("#"):
78|                pre_kw = set(re.findall(r"[a-z]{4,}", line.lower()))
79|                break
80|
81|    return {"name": name, "pre": pre_kw, "post": post_kw, "path": str(path)}
82|
83|
84|def _build_graph(skills: list[dict]) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
85|    """Build adjacency list: skill → list of skills it enables."""
86|    graph: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
87|
88|    for i, a in enumerate(skills):
89|        for j, b in enumerate(skills):
90|            if i == j:
91|                continue
92|            # Edge A→B if A's postconditions overlap B's preconditions
93|            overlap = a["post"] & b["pre"]
94|            if len(overlap) >= 2:   # require ≥2 keyword overlap
95|                graph[a["name"]].append(b["name"])
96|
97|    return dict(graph)
98|
99|
100|def _bfs_reachable(graph: dict[str, list[str]], start: str) -> set[str]:
101|    visited = {start}
102|    queue   = deque([start])
103|    while queue:
104|        node = queue.popleft()
105|        for nb in graph.get(node, []):
106|            if nb not in visited:
107|                visited.add(nb)
108|                queue.append(nb)
109|    return visited
110|
111|
112|def _find_dead_ends(skills: list[dict], graph: dict[str, list[str]]) -> list[str]:
113|    dead_ends = []
114|    for skill in skills:
115|        name = skill["name"]
116|        if name not in graph or not graph[name]:
117|            # No outgoing edges — check if postconditions look terminal
118|            post_text = " ".join(skill["post"])
119|            if not any(w in post_text for w in TERMINAL_WORDS):
120|                dead_ends.append(name)
121|    return dead_ends
122|
123|
124|def run(from_skill: str | None, to_skill: str | None,
125|        plan_file: Path | None, audit_all: bool, dry_run: bool) -> int:
126|    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
127|
128|    # Load skills
129|    skill_files: list[Path] = []
130|    for base in [SKILLS_DIR, FORK_SKILLS]:
131|        if base.exists():
132|            skill_files.extend(base.rglob("SKILL.md"))
133|
134|    skills = [_extract_skill_meta(f) for f in skill_files]
135|    skills = [s for s in skills if s.get("name")]
136|
137|    print(f"\n=== Skill Graph Reachability Verifier — {now[:10]} ===")
138|    print(f"Skills loaded: {len(skills)}")
139|
140|    graph     = _build_graph(skills)
141|    edge_count = sum(len(v) for v in graph.values())
142|    print(f"Graph: {len(graph)} nodes with edges, {edge_count} total edges")
143|
144|    results: list[dict] = []
145|
146|    if from_skill and to_skill:
147|        # Point-to-point reachability
148|        reachable = _bfs_reachable(graph, from_skill)
149|        ok        = to_skill in reachable
150|        print(f"\n  {from_skill} → {to_skill}: {'REACHABLE' if ok else 'UNREACHABLE'}")
151|        print(f"  ({len(reachable)} skills reachable from {from_skill})")
152|        results.append({"from": from_skill, "to": to_skill, "reachable": ok})
153|        alarm_exit = 0 if ok else 1
154|
155|    elif plan_file and plan_file.exists():
156|        plan   = json.loads(plan_file.read_text())
157|        chain  = plan.get("skills", plan.get("steps", []))
158|        broken = []
159|        for i in range(len(chain) - 1):
160|            a, b   = chain[i], chain[i+1]
161|            reach  = _bfs_reachable(graph, a)
162|            if b not in reach:
163|                broken.append((a, b))
164|        if broken:
165|            print(f"\nBroken links in plan:")
166|            for a, b in broken:
167|                print(f"  {a} ↛ {b}")
168|            alarm_exit = 1
169|        else:
170|            print(f"\nPlan is fully reachable ({len(chain)} skills)")
171|            alarm_exit = 0
172|        results.append({"plan": str(plan_file), "broken": broken})
173|
174|    else:
175|        # Audit: find all dead-end skills and connectivity stats
176|        dead_ends     = _find_dead_ends(skills, graph)
177|        isolated      = [s["name"] for s in skills if s["name"] not in graph]
178|        largest_comp  = max((len(_bfs_reachable(graph, s["name"])) for s in skills[:20]), default=0)
179|
180|        print(f"Dead-end skills (no outgoing edges, non-terminal): {len(dead_ends)}")
181|        print(f"Isolated skills (no edges at all): {len(isolated)}")
182|        print(f"Largest reachable component (sample): {largest_comp} skills")
183|
184|        if dead_ends[:5]:
185|            print(f"Sample dead-ends: {dead_ends[:5]}")
186|
187|        results.append({
188|            "dead_ends": len(dead_ends),
189|            "isolated":  len(isolated),
190|            "largest_component": largest_comp,
191|        })
192|        alarm_exit = 0
193|        # Only alarm if dead-end count has INCREASED from baseline (not just the permanent baseline state)
194|        baseline_dead = 0
195|        if BASELINE_FILE.exists():
196|            try:
197|                bl = json.loads(BASELINE_FILE.read_text())
198|                baseline_dead = bl.get("dead_ends", 0)
199|            except Exception:
200|                pass
201|        else:
202|            # First run: write baseline, don't alarm
203|            _bl_tmp = BASELINE_FILE.with_suffix(".tmp")
204|            _bl_tmp.write_text(json.dumps({"dead_ends": len(dead_ends), "ts": now}, indent=2))
205|            _bl_tmp.replace(BASELINE_FILE)
206|            baseline_dead = len(dead_ends)
207|
208|        new_dead = len(dead_ends) - baseline_dead
209|        if new_dead > 5:   # alarm only when 5+ new dead-ends appear beyond baseline
210|            alarm_exit = 1
211|            print(f"\nALARM: yes — {new_dead} new dead-end skills since baseline (total={len(dead_ends)}, baseline={baseline_dead})")
212|        else:
213|            print(f"\nALARM: no — dead-end count stable (total={len(dead_ends)}, baseline={baseline_dead}, delta={new_dead:+d})")
214|
215|    if not dry_run:
216|        OUT_FILE.write_text(json.dumps({"ts": now, "results": results}, indent=2))
217|
218|    return alarm_exit
219|
220|
221|def main() -> None:
222|    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
223|    p.add_argument("--from",      dest="from_skill", default=None)
224|    p.add_argument("--to",        dest="to_skill",   default=None)
225|    p.add_argument("--plan",      type=Path,         default=None)
226|    p.add_argument("--audit-all", action="store_true")
227|    p.add_argument("--dry-run",   action="store_true")
228|    args = p.parse_args()
229|    sys.exit(run(args.from_skill, args.to_skill, args.plan, args.audit_all, args.dry_run))
230|
231|
232|if __name__ == "__main__":
233|    main()

================================================================================
FILE: /var/home/rainbow/.hermes/scripts/spec-semantic-graph-builder.py  (total lines: 230)
================================================================================
1|#!/usr/bin/python3
2|"""
3|spec-semantic-graph-builder.py
4|
5|Enables automated detection of missing security guards and state-transition
6|invariants in Hermes skill/plan specifications by building a semantic
7|dependency graph from SKILL.md and plan files.
8|
9|CS SPIKE basis (CS wave5 — spec semantic analysis):
10|  LLM-generated code and skill specs lack formal intent verification.
11|  This script builds a directed graph from skill preconditions, postconditions,
12|  tool dependencies, and guard clauses — then detects:
13|  (a) Missing security guards (skill invokes destructive tool with no guard)
14|  (b) Unreachable postconditions (no path from precondition to postcondition)
15|  (c) State-transition gaps (required prior state never established)
16|
17|Math basis: semantic graph as a typed directed hypergraph
18|  Nodes: {precondition, action, postcondition, guard}
19|  Edges: REQUIRES, PRODUCES, GUARDS, CONFLICTS_WITH
20|  Invariant check: for every PRODUCES edge (a→p), there must exist a
21|  reachable GUARDS edge (g→a) when action `a` is destructive.
22|  Gap detection: BFS from initial state; unreachable postconditions flagged.
23|
24|Usage:
25|  python3 spec-semantic-graph-builder.py              # scan all skills
26|  python3 spec-semantic-graph-builder.py --skill NAME # single skill
27|  python3 spec-semantic-graph-builder.py --export graph.json
28|  python3 spec-semantic-graph-builder.py --dry-run
29|"""
30|
31|from __future__ import annotations
32|
33|import argparse
34|import json
35|import re
36|import sys
37|from collections import defaultdict, deque
38|from datetime import datetime, timezone
39|from pathlib import Path
40|
41|HOME       = Path.home()
42|SKILLS_DIR = HOME / ".hermes/skills"
43|FORK_SKILLS = HOME / ".hermes/profiles/fork/skills"
44|PLANS_DIR  = HOME / ".hermes/plans"
45|CACHE_DIR  = HOME / ".hermes/cache/monitors"
46|CACHE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
47|OUT_FILE      = CACHE_DIR / "spec-semantic-graph.json"
48|BASELINE_FILE = CACHE_DIR / "spec-semantic-graph-baseline.json"
49|
50|# Patterns for extracting semantic elements from SKILL.md
51|GUARD_PATTERNS = [
52|    r"(?i)\b(check|verify|validate|assert|ensure|guard|require|must)\b[^.\n]{0,60}",
53|    r"(?i)\b(if .{0,30} then|only if|unless|except when)\b[^.\n]{0,60}",
54|    r"(?i)\b(auth|permission|access|token|credential)\b[^.\n]{0,40}",
55|]
56|DESTRUCTIVE_KEYWORDS = {
57|    "delete", "remove", "drop", "truncate", "overwrite", "destroy",
58|    "kill", "terminate", "wipe", "reset", "purge", "rmdir", "unlink",
59|}
60|PRECONDITION_HEADERS  = re.compile(r"(?i)^#{1,4}\s*(precondition|prerequisite|requires?|before|setup)")
61|POSTCONDITION_HEADERS = re.compile(r"(?i)^#{1,4}\s*(postcondition|produces?|output|result|after|effect)")
62|ACTION_HEADERS        = re.compile(r"(?i)^#{1,4}\s*(step|action|procedure|workflow|usage|use when)")
63|
64|
65|def _extract_nodes(text: str, source: str) -> dict:
66|    lines  = text.splitlines()
67|    nodes: dict[str, list[str]] = {
68|        "preconditions": [], "postconditions": [], "actions": [], "guards": [],
69|    }
70|    mode = None
71|    for line in lines:
72|        if PRECONDITION_HEADERS.match(line):
73|            mode = "preconditions"
74|        elif POSTCONDITION_HEADERS.match(line):
75|            mode = "postconditions"
76|        elif ACTION_HEADERS.match(line):
77|            mode = "actions"
78|        elif line.startswith("#"):
79|            mode = None
80|
81|        if mode and line.strip() and not line.startswith("#"):
82|            nodes[mode].append(line.strip()[:120])
83|
84|        for pat in GUARD_PATTERNS:
85|            m = re.search(pat, line)
86|            if m:
87|                nodes["guards"].append(m.group()[:80])
88|
89|    return nodes
90|
91|
92|def _find_destructive_actions(nodes: dict) -> list[str]:
93|    destructive = []
94|    for action in nodes.get("actions", []):
95|        words = set(re.findall(r"[a-z]+", action.lower()))
96|        if words & DESTRUCTIVE_KEYWORDS:
97|            destructive.append(action[:80])
98|    return destructive
99|
100|
101|def _check_guard_coverage(nodes: dict) -> list[dict]:
102|    """Flag destructive actions that have no associated guard."""
103|    issues = []
104|    guards_text = " ".join(nodes.get("guards", [])).lower()
105|    for action in _find_destructive_actions(nodes):
106|        # Check if any guard keyword appears near this action's key terms
107|        action_words = set(re.findall(r"[a-z]{4,}", action.lower()))
108|        covered = any(w in guards_text for w in action_words)
109|        if not covered:
110|            issues.append({
111|                "type":   "MISSING_GUARD",
112|                "action": action,
113|                "detail": "destructive action with no guard clause found in spec",
114|            })
115|    return issues
116|
117|
118|def _check_postcondition_reachability(nodes: dict) -> list[dict]:
119|    """Flag postconditions that have no matching action producing them."""
120|    issues = []
121|    actions_text = " ".join(nodes.get("actions", [])).lower()
122|    for pc in nodes.get("postconditions", []):
123|        pc_words = set(re.findall(r"[a-z]{4,}", pc.lower()))
124|        reachable = any(w in actions_text for w in pc_words)
125|        if not reachable and pc_words:
126|            issues.append({
127|                "type":        "UNREACHABLE_POSTCONDITION",
128|                "postcondition": pc[:80],
129|                "detail":      "postcondition has no action that produces it",
130|            })
131|    return issues
132|
133|
134|def analyse_skill(path: Path) -> dict:
135|    try:
136|        text = path.read_text()
137|    except Exception as e:
138|        return {"path": str(path), "error": str(e), "issues": []}
139|
140|    nodes  = _extract_nodes(text, str(path))
141|    issues = (
142|        _check_guard_coverage(nodes) +
143|        _check_postcondition_reachability(nodes)
144|    )
145|
146|    return {
147|        "path":   str(path),
148|        "name":   path.parent.name if path.name == "SKILL.md" else path.stem,
149|        "nodes":  {k: len(v) for k, v in nodes.items()},
150|        "issues": issues,
151|    }
152|
153|
154|def run(skill_name: str | None, export: Path | None, dry_run: bool) -> int:
155|    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
156|
157|    # Collect skill files
158|    skill_files: list[Path] = []
159|    for base in [SKILLS_DIR, FORK_SKILLS]:
160|        if base.exists():
161|            skill_files.extend(base.rglob("SKILL.md"))
162|    if PLANS_DIR.exists():
163|        skill_files.extend(PLANS_DIR.glob("*.md"))
164|
165|    if skill_name:
166|        skill_files = [f for f in skill_files if skill_name.lower() in str(f).lower()]
167|
168|    print(f"\n=== Spec Semantic Graph Builder — {now[:10]} ===")
169|    print(f"Analysing {len(skill_files)} spec files...")
170|
171|    results    = [analyse_skill(f) for f in skill_files]
172|    all_issues = [i for r in results for i in r.get("issues", [])]
173|
174|    by_type: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
175|    for issue in all_issues:
176|        by_type[issue["type"]] += 1
177|
178|    print(f"Files analysed: {len(results)}")
179|    print(f"Total issues:   {len(all_issues)}")
180|    for t, c in sorted(by_type.items()):
181|        print(f"  {t}: {c}")
182|
183|    critical = [i for i in all_issues if i["type"] == "MISSING_GUARD"]
184|    if critical[:3]:
185|        print("\nTop MISSING_GUARD issues:")
186|        for i in critical[:3]:
187|            print(f"  ! {i['action'][:70]}")
188|
189|    # Only alarm on NEW issues beyond baseline (static structural issues are permanent noise)
190|    baseline_count = 0
191|    if BASELINE_FILE.exists():
192|        try:
193|            baseline_count = json.loads(BASELINE_FILE.read_text()).get("issue_count", 0)
194|        except Exception:
195|            pass
196|    else:
197|        _bl_tmp = BASELINE_FILE.with_suffix(".tmp")
198|        _bl_tmp.write_text(json.dumps({"issue_count": len(all_issues), "ts": now}, indent=2))
199|        _bl_tmp.replace(BASELINE_FILE)
200|        baseline_count = len(all_issues)
201|
202|    new_issues = len(all_issues) - baseline_count
203|    if new_issues > 5:
204|        print(f"\nALARM: yes — {new_issues} new spec issues since baseline (total={len(all_issues)}, baseline={baseline_count})")
205|        alarm_exit = 1
206|    else:
207|        print(f"\nALARM: no — issue count stable (total={len(all_issues)}, baseline={baseline_count}, delta={new_issues:+d})")
208|        alarm_exit = 0
209|
210|    if not dry_run:
211|        payload = {"ts": now, "files": len(results), "issues": all_issues, "by_type": dict(by_type)}
212|        OUT_FILE.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2))
213|        if export:
214|            export.write_text(json.dumps({"results": results}, indent=2))
215|            print(f"Graph exported: {export}")
216|
217|    return alarm_exit
218|
219|
220|def main() -> None:
221|    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
222|    parser.add_argument("--skill",  default=None)
223|    parser.add_argument("--export", type=Path, default=None)
224|    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
225|    args = parser.parse_args()
226|    sys.exit(run(skill_name=args.skill, export=args.export, dry_run=args.dry_run))
227|
228|
229|if __name__ == "__main__":
230|    main()

================================================================================
FILE: /var/home/rainbow/.hermes/profiles/fork/ARCHITECTURE.md  (total lines: 382)
================================================================================
1|# Hermes Architecture — Canonical Reference
2|
3|Patterns ported from Denuto (jesterG1979/hello_agent) + Hermes-native patterns.
4|This is the authoritative single source of truth for how Hermes is structured,
5|what rules are enforced, and what the invariants are.
6|
7|Last updated: 2026-09-16 (wiring sprint 2 + book-to-skill ingestion)
8|
9|---
10|
11|## Tier System
12|
13|Rules are split into two tiers (borrowed from Denuto's architecture contract):
14|
15|Tier 1 — Enforced Invariants: hard rules. Each names the check that enforces it
16|  (a script, test, or hook). An agent may not weaken or route around a Tier-1 rule
17|  in a normal change. If a rule has no gate, it is marked GATE GAP.
18|
19|Tier 2 — Operating Posture: non-binding guidance. Real, but not mechanically
20|  checkable. An agent must NOT cite a Tier-2 statement to claim a change is "verified."
21|
22|Honesty rule: if a rule has no gate today, mark it GATE GAP (proposed: ...) rather
23|than implying it runs. Gate gaps accumulate into a backlog.
24|
25|---
26|
27|## Tier 1 — Enforced Invariants
28|
29|### H-I1 — Skills are the single source of truth for agent procedures
30|- Skills in ~/.hermes/profiles/fork/skills/ are canonical.
31|- User-owned skills require `hermes curator adopt` before any curator write.
32|- No procedure lives only in memory or in session history.
33|- GATE: skillspector_guard.py runs on cron every 235m (post-facto batch scan).
34|- GATE (H-I1: skillspector pre-commit hook): CLOSED — pre-commit hook installed at
35|  ~/.hermes/hermes-fork/.git/hooks/pre-commit; scans staged SKILL.md files via
36|  `HERMES_PROFILE=fork python3 ~/.hermes/scripts/skillspector_guard.py --enforce`
37|  and blocks the commit (exit 1) on high-risk findings. Fail-open: absent guard → warn + exit 0.
38|
39|### H-I2 — Memory surfaces have strict ownership (one writer per fact class)
40|- skills: reusable procedures and task-specific patterns
41|- memory: facts that apply to EVERY session regardless of task (who the user is, env facts, conventions)
42|- session history: within-session recall, transient state
43|- Overlapping stores with no ownership rule = four places a stale claim can survive.
44|- No mirroring: a fact lives in exactly one store. Cross-reference by link; never copy.
45|
46|### H-I3 — Evidence over assertion
47|- Claims about tool results, file writes, deploys, and fixes must include verifiable output.
48|- "Implemented, not yet tested" is a valid status. An unqualified success claim without evidence is not.
49|- Report failures faithfully. Never round a partial pass up to "passing."
50|- State skipped steps: if a required step was skipped, name it and say why.
51|- Source: Denuto golden-principles.md #2, agent-operating-rules.md Progress Reporting section.
52|
53|### H-I4 — No same feedback twice
54|- Corrective user steering is a high-signal defect report against the agent operating system.
55|- Convert repeated or behavior-level feedback into a durable control: skill update, memory update,
56|  config change, script, or cron job.
57|- Empty assurances ("I will remember", "going forward") are not a fix unless backed by a durable control.
58|- Source: Denuto golden-principles.md #11, agent-steering-feedback-loop.md.
59|
60|### H-I5 — Small, reversible changes
61|- Prefer narrow changes that are easy to review, test, and roll back.
62|- Especially before touching config.yaml, plugin hooks, or runtime scripts.
63|- Source: Denuto golden-principles.md #3.
64|
65|### H-I6 — Hermes scripts must be stdlib-only unless explicitly approved
66|- Scripts in ~/.hermes/scripts/ must not introduce new pip deps without explicit approval.
67|- Exception: lyapunov-analysis.py uses numpy/scipy (pre-approved, analysis-only, never on critical path).
68|- Use execute_code + Path.write_text() to write scripts (write_file false-alarms on scripts/).
69|- Source: local convention, discovered 2026-09-16.
70|
71|### H-I7 — Shadow paths never raise; annotation only
72|- Any shadow/telemetry/middleware annotation path MUST swallow all exceptions.
73|- A shadow failure must not contaminate the live path.
74|- Source: Denuto shadow_telemetry.py design constraint.
75|
76|### H-I8 — Improvement proposals are risk-classified before execution
77|- LOW (skill_update, skill_create, memory_update): auto-approved.
78|- MEDIUM (script_add, script_modify, cron_add): needs 1 reviewer.
79|- HIGH (config_change, plugin_update, cron_modify): needs 2 senior approvals + 24h cooldown after rollback.
80|- These targets always escalate to HIGH: config.yaml, plugin_stream_hooks, conversation_compression,
81|  api_request_hooks, gateway, compression.
82|- CLI: python3 ~/.hermes/scripts/improvement_governance.py propose --change-type TYPE --target TARGET --description DESC
83|- GATE (H-I8 advisory): tool_guardrails.py _governance_pre_check() fires for HIGH-risk .hermes writes;
84|  fail-open advisory (does not hard-block). Full GATE GAP: no hard-blocking auto-call exists yet in agent runtime.
85|
86|---
87|
88|## Tier 2 — Operating Posture
89|
90|### Agent loop design
91|- Deterministic control plane wrapping nondeterministic LLM nodes is the textbook-correct shape.
92|- Keep deterministic logic and LLM judgment physically separated where possible.
93|- Source: Denuto I5 invariant + AWS GenAI Lens guidance.
94|
95|### Ponytail (lazy senior dev mode)
96|Before writing any agent code or skill, stop at the first rung that holds:
97|  1. Does this need to be built at all? (YAGNI)
98|  2. Does the standard library already do this?
99|  3. Does a native Hermes feature cover it?
100|  4. Does an already-installed dependency solve it?
101|  5. Can this be one line?
102|  6. Only then: write the minimum that works.
103|
104|Not lazy about: input validation at trust boundaries, error handling that prevents
105|data loss, security, and anything explicitly requested.
106|Source: Denuto ponytail-lazy-senior-dev.md.
107|
108|### Memory division of labour
109|- Session history: what we just tried, why we backed out. Do NOT write durable facts here.
110|- memory: who the user is, env facts, standing conventions. Max 2200 chars — consolidate aggressively.
111|- skills: task-specific procedures, patterns, pitfalls, tool commands. Load only when relevant.
112|- Citation rule: any claim that changes a skill or config must cite a tool result from this session.
113|- Promotion rule: a fact recalled from session history that matters gets written to skill/memory in the same session.
114|- No-mirroring rule: a fact lives in exactly one store. Two copies = one of them is wrong.
115|Source: Denuto harness-and-memory-contract.md.
116|
117|### Concurrency (AIMD controller)
118|- Use ~/.hermes/scripts/aimd_controller.py for bounded parallel subagent dispatch.
119|- AIMD limitation: each subagent has independent state — no cross-agent convergence.
120|- For truly concurrent work, prefer delegate_task with explicit output contracts.
121|
122|### Skill routing
123|- Primary: BM25 index (skill-router-index.py, build_tfidf with k1=1.5, b=0.75).
124|- Semantic fallback: when BM25 top-2 score gap < 0.12, concept-lattice-index.py is called
125|  via subprocess --query to re-rank candidates. Output flags semantic_reranked=True.
126|- Known failure: concept-lattice requires a warm Hindsight cache; falls back to pure BM25 if cold.
127|
128|### Loop stability (PID + internal Lyapunov check)
129|- loop-pid.py implements discrete linear PID with anti-windup and an internal Lyapunov decrease
130|  check (cmd_lyapunov_check, citing KHALIL-1/KHALIL-7). This is self-contained in loop-pid.py.
131|- lyapunov-analysis.py is a SEPARATE standalone tool (requires numpy/scipy) for offline phase-portrait
132|  and bifurcation analysis. It is NOT called by loop-pid.py. Use it manually for stability diagnosis.
133|- Do NOT claim "loop-pid is wired to lyapunov-analysis" — they are independent instruments.
134|
135|### Middleware stack
136|- See ~/.hermes/profiles/fork/skills/hermes-llm-middleware-stack/SKILL.md for composable middleware.
137|- Loop detection: MD5-hash responses per (session_id, stage). Catches syntactically identical loops.
138|- Rephrased-loop detection: _is_rephrased_loop() in metacognitive-harness.py — 4-gram Jaccard
139|  similarity over last 5 history items (threshold=0.85). Catches semantically equivalent paraphrases.
140|- Cost guard: redirect to cheaper model when cumulative cost > threshold.
141|- Grounding: verify quoted strings against source text. Annotate only, never retry.
142|
143|### Shadow evaluation
144|- See ~/.hermes/profiles/fork/skills/hermes-shadow-evaluation/SKILL.md.
145|- New features ship behind shadow_<feature>: false flags before going live.
146|- Gate script at ~/.hermes/scripts/shadow_telemetry.py evaluates JSONL telemetry.
147|- Nightly report: shadow-gate-nightly.py cron job (0 8 * * *, no_agent=True, id=shadow-gate-0001).
148|  Reads ~/.hermes/cache/shadow-telemetry/*.jsonl; prints promote/disable/keep-shadow per flag.
149|
150|### Improvement governance
151|- See ~/.hermes/profiles/fork/skills/hermes-improvement-governance/SKILL.md.
152|- Gate script at ~/.hermes/scripts/improvement_governance.py classifies risk and tracks proposals.
153|- CLI subcommands: propose, approve, rollback, list.
154|- GATE GAP: agent runtime does not call this automatically before HIGH-risk writes.
155|
156|### Run ledger
157|- See ~/.hermes/scripts/run_ledger.py for durable agent task state with OCC conditional writes.
158|- Hash-chain audit log, clock injection, IllegalRunTransition on invalid state machine transitions.
159|- CLI subcommands: create, complete, fail, status.
160|
161|### Consistency scoring
162|- See ~/.hermes/scripts/consistency_scorer.py for calibrated LLM confidence.
163|- N=3 Condorcet majority: 3/3=1.0, 2/3=0.5, 1/3=0.2, 0/3=0.05 (conservative, not prob-theoretically derived).
164|- Wired into metacognitive-harness.py cmd_gate() for L2/L3 scope factual claims (MH_CONSISTENCY=1 env var).
165|- Calibration logging: (predicted_confidence, query_hash, scope) appended to ~/.hermes/cache/calibration-log.jsonl.
166|
167|### Context compression advisory
168|- rd-compaction-advisor.py is called by pre-compact-annotate.py (runs every 15m, no_agent=True).
169|- Estimates aggressiveness [0,1] from current token count vs threshold (R-D curve shape, k=3).
170|- Appended to annotation output as: "Compaction advisory: aggressiveness=X.XX, focus=TOPIC".
171|- NOTE: rd-compaction-advisor.py is NOT wired into context_compressor.py directly — it is an advisory
172|  annotation only. The compressor does not read the annotation and adapt its salvage pass.
173|
174|### Dead config sections (confirmed 2026-09-16)
175|The following config.yaml sections have zero AGENT-RUNTIME consumers in agent/*.py. They are documented aspirations,
176|not enforced gates in the agent loop. Do NOT cite them as active enforcement:
177|  - calibration_gate: commitment_threshold defined but never evaluated in agent runtime
178|  - constraint_freshness: config key read by memory-ttl-purge only (not agent routing) — now profile-aware via HERMES_HOME
179|  - durable_file_write_gate: 0 agent/*.py consumers
180|  - skill_state: 0 agent/*.py consumers (read by skill-state.py standalone script)
181|  - tool_slo: 0 agent/*.py consumers (am-sentry.py implements SLO detection independently)
182|  - loop_harness: 0 agent/*.py consumers (reasoning-hooks.py reads via env-aware HERMES_HOME)
183|
184|---
185|
186|## Runtime Scripts Reference
187|
188|~/.hermes/scripts/:
